name: identity_sessions
description: Authenticated continuity for a Person: method, surface, assurance and expiry. Direct-URL sessions hold a rotating refresh credential (hash only); embedded sessions have none and renew through a new host proof.
lifecycle: Expire at idle or absolute limits; revoked on logout, Person disable, credential reset, refresh reuse, or explicit revocation. Expired rows are pruned by the application after 7 days.

columns.Meaning: Session UUID; carried as the access-token sid claim.
Proof used: local, pdt, sankhya, bootstrap or enrollment.
Where the session started: direct, pdt or sankhya. Never used for authorization.
single or mfa; administrative operations require mfa.
SHA-256 of the current refresh credential.
columns.Null meaning: Embedded or revoked session without refresh.

columns.Meaning: SHA-256 of the previous refresh credential; presenting it revokes the session as reuse.
Instant of the latest primary or step-up authentication; drives recent-authentication checks.
Application-clock last user activity reported by the browser (or sign-in); the inactivity deadline is derived from it.
Application-clock idle expiry, extended on refresh but never past expires_at.

When the refresh credential last rotated. A request presenting the immediately previous credential within a short grace window is a concurrent refresh of the same browser and receives an access token without rotation; later presentations are treated as reuse and revoke the session.

constraints.Purpose: Idle expiry and authentication time cannot exceed the absolute expiry.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((method)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['local'::character varying, 'pdt'::character varying, 'sankhya'::character varying, 'bootstrap'::character varying, 'enrollment'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.Purpose: Revocation instant and reason exist together.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX identity_sessions_expiry_idx ON public.identity_sessions USING btree (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX identity_sessions_person_idx ON public.identity_sessions USING btree (person_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_sessions_previous_refresh_key ON public.identity_sessions USING btree (previous_refresh_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_sessions_refresh_key ON public.identity_sessions USING btree (refresh_hash)
constraints.Purpose: A refresh credential maps to one session.
